review_candidates.title: Content Creator
review_candidates.description: Content Creator Company: Zoa Group Salary: £30,000 per annum Location: Hybrid, with three days a week in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, and remaining days remote. At least two days a month at our warehouse location in Corby, Northamptonshire to shoot content. Contract: Permanent, full-time Reporting to: Head of Marketing About Zoa Group Zoa Group brings together leading circular economy brands, helping more products find their next owner or user through resale and rental. Our brands include Thrift+, Hirestreet, Wowzer and Reuseabook, each with its own audience, personality and customer journey. Initially, your work will focus on Thrift+ and Hirestreet, with Wowzer and Reuseabook joining the content programme as their requirements develop. Working across the group offers the variety of industry and content creation style. You’ll explore different products, audiences and creative approaches while being part of one team and seeing the longer-term impact of your work. About the role You’ll own content creation across the group, developing ideas, planning shoots, getting behind and in front of the camera, and editing your work into finished content. Your output will include short-form organic social videos, paid social ad creative, photography and static content. You’ll adapt your approach to each brand while keeping a clear focus on what the content needs to achieve. You’ll report to the Head of Marketing and bring your ideas forward for discussion. Together, you’ll refine the concepts and agree priorities before you take responsibility for execution. We’re looking for someone who can manage the process from idea to finished asset, organise their own workload and consistently deliver strong work. Each piece of content will be created in keeping with the brand's guidelines, representing at least one of the core content pillars. Your initial focus You’ll begin with a focused project for Thrift+, developing content ideas, establishing repeatable formats and building a consistent production and delivery schedule. Once a reliable content cadence is in place for Thrift+, you’ll extend your work to Hirestreet. Wowzer and Reuseabook will follow as their content requirements come into scope. You’ll agree priorities and timings with the Head of Marketing, building a sustainable content programme as each brand is introduced. What you’ll do Develop content ideas informed by audience interests, brand priorities, trends and previous performance. Bring concepts and recommendations to the Head of Marketing, then develop agreed ideas into finished content. Plan out the key dates for the annual content calendar Plan and execute the monthly content calendar Plan and shoot short-form video for organic social channels and paid advertising. Edit your own footage, including hooks, pacing, captions, sound and calls to action. Confidently appear on camera, present products and explain our services in a natural, engaging way. Photograph products, people and behind-the-scenes activity, and create static assets for social and advertising. Find stories within our warehouses, products, teams and customer experiences. Adapt content for different brands, audiences, platforms and formats as the programme expands. Create alternative hooks, edits and messaging to test what performs best. Analyse the performance of your videos, including retention curves, watch time, completion rates, engagement and click-through. Identify where viewers lose interest or drop off, and use those insights to improve hooks, pacing, structure, length and calls to action. Turn those findings into new edits and content ideas, testing and refining your approach to improve audience retention and commercial results. Manage shoot planning, asset organisation and delivery deadlines. What we’re looking for Practical experience creating content for a brand, business or your own established channels, supported by a strong portfolio. Proficiency in both shooting and editing, with the ability to produce finished content independently. A strong understanding of short-form video, including what earns attention and keeps people watching. The ability to create both organic social content and paid social ad creative, understanding their different objectives. Confidence appearing on camera and presenting. Strong photography skills and an eye for composition, lighting and visual storytelling. Understanding of trends and an ability to adapt them to fit our brands. Commercial awareness: you understand how content can encourage someone to visit a website, buy a product, rent an outfit or start a subscription. Strong organisation and the ability to manage priorities across several brands. A proactive approach, bringing ideas and solutions without waiting for a detailed brief. Proficiency in CapCut or similar software such as Da Vinci or Premiere Pro. Ability to use mics and lighting where required. Comfortable editing in social Apps (TikTok, Edits, Instagram) where trending audio or video performance will benefit Nice to have Experience in fashion, resale, rental, retail or circular businesses would be valuable. We’re most interested in the quality of your work, your contribution to it and what you’ve learned from the results. How we’ll measure success We want content that builds our audiences and helps turn interest into action. We’ll assess your work through audience growth, meaningful engagement, website click-through and contribution to sales, rentals and subscriptions. You’ll work with the Head of Marketing to understand performance, identify what’s working and improve the next round of content. Working arrangement This is a permanent, full-time role with three days a week based in Cheltenham and the remaining days working remotely, alongside at least two days a month at our warehouse in Corby. Travel to Corby will be paid for by the business. Your usual travel to Cheltenham will be at your own expense. You should be based within practical travelling distance of Cheltenham and able to attend Corby regularly. How to apply Please apply with your CV and a portfolio or links to relevant work. Include: Three examples of content you have created, explaining your involvement in the idea, shooting, editing and presenting. Any available performance results, particularly audience growth, engagement, website traffic or conversions. A short explanation of one piece of content that performed well and why you think it worked. Please also confirm your location, notice period and salary expectations.

review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Fondé en 1933, International Rescue Committee (IRC) a pour mission d'aider les personnes dont la vie et les moyens de subsistance ont été brisés par des conflits et des catastrophes à survivre, se rétablir et reprendre leur avenir en main. Depuis 1996, IRC-RDC répond aux besoins humanitaires et de développement des populations congolaises et réfugiées en RDC, tout en s’efforçant de promouvoir leurs droits et de renforcer leur santé, leur sécurité, leur bien-être économique, leur éducation et leur pouvoir décisionnel. Actuellement, IRC intervient dans les domaines de la santé (y compris sexuelle et reproductive), de la nutrition, de l’eau, l’hygiène et l’assainissement (WASH), de la protection de l’enfance et des femmes, de la bonne gouvernance et de la gestion des conflits, et enfin, du redressement économique et du développement. Dans le cadre de la Phase III du Projet STAR-RDC, sous sa Composante 6 : Réponse intégrée et résilience communautaires face aux violences basées sur le genre (VBG) pour la période allant de Octobre 2026 au 31 décembre 2027, l’IRC en RDC, en tant que prestataire de l’Unité de Gestion de projet (UGP), aura à coordonner, accompagner et s’assurer du renforcement des capacités des structures partenaires œuvrant dans la prise en charge des survivantes des VBG, en particulier l’ONG SOFEPADI, l’ONG APDEC et les 6 CISM ciblés par le Projet (Mai Ndombe, Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, Ituri). Cette phase cible environ 11400 bénéficiaires directs dont 8900 survivants (e)s de VBG,1400 d’enfant/jeunes encadrés au niveau du Centre récréatif, 2000 survivantes des VBG éligibles bénéficiaires de la subvention des ARG et prévoit notamment la prise en charge de 705 cas de fistules et prolapsus, la réalisation de 4 cliniques mobiles de chirurgies réparatrices, et l’administration de kits PEP à 1780 survivant (e)s de viol dans le délai de 72 heures. DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE Sous la supervision directe du/de la Senior Supply Chain Manager, et la supervision technique du/de la Manager Asset, Inventories and Fleet, le Capitaine de canot rapide a la charge de la conduite sûre, efficace et conforme aux normes de sécurité de l'embarcation, pour le transport de passagers et de marchandises sur le tronçon fluvial Kinshasa – Bandundu, dans la province du Mai-Ndombe. RESPONSABILITÉS CLES Navigation et conduite de l'embarcation Piloter le canot rapide en respectant les règles de navigation fluviale ainsi que les itinéraires autorisés ; Planifier les trajets en tenant compte du niveau d'eau, des courants, des bancs de sable et des obstacles saisonniers propres au tronçon Kinshasa–Bandundu ; Adapter la vitesse et la conduite aux conditions météorologiques ainsi qu'à l'état du fleuve. Sécurité Vérifier, avant chaque départ, l'état général de l'embarcation, le niveau de carburant et la présence des équipements de sécurité obligatoires (gilets de sauvetage, extincteurs, trousse de premiers secours, moyens de communication VHF, GPS et téléphone satellite) ; Assurer la sécurité des passagers et du chargement pendant toute la durée du trajet, notamment en respectant la capacité maximale autorisée. Signaler sans délai toute panne, tout incident, toute situation à risque ou toute non-conformité constatée ; Appliquer strictement les procédures de sécurité et le Code de conduite de l'IRC, y compris les règles relatives à la protection contre l'exploitation et les abus sexuels (PSEA). Entretien de l'embarcation Assurer l'entretien courant du moteur et de la coque (vidanges, nettoyage et petites réparations) ; Signaler les besoins de maintenance ou de réparations majeures au/à la responsable logistique ; Veiller à la bonne conservation du matériel embarqué (carburant, pièces de rechange et équipements de sécurité). Encadrement des matelots/assistants de bord Superviser et encadrer le(s) matelot(s)/assistant(s) de bord affecté(s) à l'embarcation : répartition des tâches, discipline et respect des consignes de sécurité ; S'assurer que chaque matelot/assistant de bord maîtrise et applique les procédures de sécurité, y compris le port des équipements de protection ; Évaluer périodiquement les performances des matelots/assistants de bord et transmettre un retour au/à la Senior Supply Chain Manager ; Veiller à ce que le(s) matelot(s) reçoive(nt) les formations nécessaires (sécurité, premiers secours et utilisation des équipements de communication).
